title: [Main]-Interest Document issued with non-taxable VAT does not generate non-taxable VAT entries in the Spanish localization
summary: Interest documents with non-taxable VAT now correctly generate non-taxable VAT entries in the Spanish localization. The fix updates the No Taxable Management codeunit to handle interest documents properly.
key_points: Interest documents issued with non-taxable VAT were not creating the required non-taxable VAT entries
The No Taxable Management codeunit was modified to address this issue
Additional test coverage was added to verify the fix works correctly
This fix is specific to the Spanish localization
VAT calculation now properly handles non-taxable interest documents
